scope: Offline local Ed25519 signing with runtime-random keys only. Includes real XDR verification in the client and backend receipt verification for eleven actions and adversarial cases. Wallet UI, admission/index/RPC response metadata and wire are doubles; no real wallet/device, consensus or submitted canary qualification.
